decision: The proposed two-file implementation is sufficient for the selected Source-only rule. No new generic listener/clock/history framework is needed. Exact functions and eight directed families below must be retained in545 implementation SPEC; this is design acceptance, not executed behavior or Native acceptance.

function_level_obligations.required: Build ordered local prior counts for Lucky through Heat (seven categories, excluding Block/debuffs). For each requested unit, derive the current tied minima, call one source choice including singleton, increment virtual prior and aggregate in first-selected order. Only after all picks grant aggregates using original parent and existing logging mode. No giveRandomBuffs delayed-mode/flush substitution; actual caps/amplification/callbacks cannot alter prior picks. Preserve Original sentinel leastStacksCount=10000 or explicitly restrict helper domain before unsupported virtual states; do not silently replace arbitrary unsupported behavior with a generalized allocator.

231 Pet-only affected predicate, existing ordered/deduplicated spatial+instance cache and self exclusion. Store real prepared coefficient as a dataclass field (None before prepare, REAL after); no serialized definition property assumption. Metadata is Source-derived explicit-instance support, not a new canAdd/shop simulation claim.

Preserve addSpeed(numAffected*p3/100.0), then beneficial signal registration, then coefficient=(p1*character.base_stamina_regen)/100.0 in this order. addSpeed is called even for zero affected targets, retaining speed/cooldown tooltip snapshot calls. Listener membership starts at onPrepare registration, not construction; use existing preparation order plus explicit prepared coefficient/registration state. No activation at prepare. Do not change all listeners or start order.

Own beneficial signals only, same ordered registered231 receivers. Delta*prepared coefficient changes live stamina_regen, then histories.character(side,20) at current global event_num. Do not use callback event.id or next_event: delayed flush can have a later global event counter. Preserve existing ended/queue semantics and any actual nested callbacks.

Normal gain cap/resist or protected zero loss does not emit a buff-change callback. A real/synthetic already-dispatched zero amount still reaches Wolpertinger onBuffChanged and Character.giveStaminaRegeneration without an amount==0 early return; snapshot call occurs, and existing same-value/type history dedup may suppress a new history row. Direct setStacks is not an emitted buff change. Distinguish callback invocation, state delta and appended history row.

least3 grant flow then existing activate, with original parent/default/null and limiter/ended behavior. Read the resulting live stamina_regen in existing character tick; no extra clock or Timer changes.

Add only231 to the existing fixed extras set alongside164/201/64/197/199, class0/default/noKing and atLeastOneExtra rules. Preserve formal75/oldinitialize/CLI/batch/Squirrel/King gates. Registered catalog82 is not formal82.
